english.title: Fail to comply with requirement imposed by enforcement officer - Single-use Vapes (England)
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse, failed to comply with a requirement imposed in the exercise of an enforcement officers powers

(A)_[for the production of, or the furnishing of extracts from, documents under regulation 10(1)(c)(iii)]_
(B)_[to afford him such facilities and assistance as were necessary under regulation 10(1)(g)]_
(C)_[to afford her such facilities and assistance as were necessary under regulation 10(1)(g)]_

of the Environmental Protection (Single-use Vapes) (England) Regulations 2024 in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 5(1)(a) and (2) of the Environmental Protection (Single-use Vapes) (England) Regulations 2024.

english.notes:
(i) See regulation 6 for application of the offence to bodies corporate.
(ii) Regulation 7 provides a defence of due diligence.
(iii) Regulation 9 provides for civil sanctions. A person may not be convicted of this criminal offence following a civil fixed monetary penalty, compliance notice or third party undertaking in respect of the act or omission giving rise to the penalty (paragraph 8(1) of the Schedule).
